sections.overview: This jack is native to tropical waters of the Indo-Pacific.
sections.identification: Adults are silvery with a row of small black flank spots; juveniles may lack spots.
sections.habitat: Records from New Caledonia and Mayotte place it in shallow water.
sections.diet: The species summary reports a diet of small fishes.
sections.behavior: It schools in pairs or small groups near reefs and surf.
sections.reproduction: The sources consulted provide little species-specific information on its spawning or early life stages.
sections.ecology: Its range extends from the Red Sea across the Indo-Pacific.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports a global IUCN category of Least Concern, assessed in 2015.
